{"reason": "Failure rows show two miss patterns: forecast-bias with amounts 0.065-0.081 fall under the 0.1 threshold, and market-mismatch=#t rows (amounts 164000-254000) are truth=demand-forecast-error but ignored. I added market-signal-mismatch as an alternate trigger and lowered the bias threshold to 0.06, converting unknowns into recovered forecast-error claims.", "source": "(define (claim-root-cause expedite-event)
  (cond
    ((and (edi-increase? expedite-event)
          (supplier-lead-time-miss? expedite-event))
     'supplier-delay)
    ((or (and (forecast-bias? expedite-event)
              (> (bias-amount expedite-event) 0.06))
         (market-signal-mismatch? expedite-event))
     'demand-forecast-error)
    (else 'unknown)))"}
